title: Are positive warnings expected in certain scenarios?
body:
Are there any instances where one might expect an analyzer to log a positive warning / alert? For example, if you are running Rayhunter on the Orbic during SIM activation with a carrier? When roaming? Are there other possible "expected" warning use cases that are less likely to be due to a nefarious actor?

I am hoping someone with a bit more experience in this area of research could share some insight or reference material. 

Thanks!

comments.body: One example sounds like it might be covered here - https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/issues/210
